description: SYNTHETIC relay test data derived from the real Zcash Testnet fixture testnet_recent.json. Not real Zcash blocks.
mutations_note: Real header 4,488,000 with one defect each; expected_equihash_error from the reference port (librustzcash equihash verify.rs) in tools/zcash_header_check.py
leaf_vectors_note: BLAKE2b-400 ('ZcashPoW', n=200, k=9) leaf strings of header 4,488,000 for its first four solution indices, computed with Python hashlib
